correctness.rationale: Baseline recomputed from pinned arrays: A,B,C_pub all Latin; |AB|=100, |AC_pub|=100, |BC_pub|=91, D0=9 with the 9 duplicate BC pairs exactly as listed. Candidate C* Latin with |AC*|=100, |BC*|=91, D*=9 confirmed. Mate-stratum census re-executed: mates-of-A 1080 transversals / 305 partitions with distribution {9:1,12:3,15:3,18:4,21:6,24:21,27:30,30:36,33:42,34:9,36:34,39:45,42:27,45:31,48:6,78:6,90:1} min 9 unique; mates-of-B 932 transversals / 5 partitions {24:1,34:3,90:1} min 24 unique. Independently cross-checked with reverse-column transversal order and highest-bit DFS cell choice plus explicit optimal-mate reconstruction (|BC|=91, Latin). Symbol-permutation C_pub->C* and shared unlabelled A-partition verified cellwise. Draft honestly limits claim to single-mate strata, discloses joint |AC|<100 & |BC|<100 region unsearched, no D=0 claim, and locates novelty in census/uniqueness not new partition. Computation is exhaustive within claimed strata (proof by enumeration), not mere heuristic evidence.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively: Egan-Wanless arXiv:1406.3681 closes mates/MOLS classification for n<=9 and gives only one closest-so-far order-10 triple (A_|_B, A_|_C_pub, |BC_pub|=91) with no order-10 triple classification and no mate/transversal census for the fixed pair; Moore prime-power complete-set theorem cannot imply order-10 facts; Donovan-Grannell-Yazici embedding theorems target large constructed orders (e.g. 9 MOLS(576)), not fixed-pair deficit; Bereg r-orthogonal spectra concern pairs/variable overlap, not simultaneous triple deficit for fixed pair; Barnoff-Bright SAT pair advances explicitly leave 3-MOLS(10) open and do not extend to fixed-pair third square. No source records 1080/305 or 932/5 counts, the deficit distributions, or the min-9-unique / min-24-unique boundaries. C* is admitted to be a symbol-relabelling of C_pub so no novelty claimed there; novelty claim is the census minima/distributions/uniqueness, which is neither recorded nor mechanically implied.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is self-contained: exact mate-stratum conditional-optimality boundary for the fixed Egan-Wanless order-10 pair (min 9 unique of 305 mates of A; min 24 unique of 5 mates of B) with full distributions and transversal counts. Object (fixed pair from published closest triple) and invariant (mate-stratum deficit minima/distributions) were motivated before computation on the recognized 3-MOLS(10) frontier (Euler-Tarry through Parker-Bose-Shrikhande to Handbook maxMOLS; Egan-Wanless Sec 8 'closest so far'; 3-MOLS(10) still open, Knuth difficulty 50). Values were not known or mechanically implied and are exactly established; a future researcher on order-10 triple extensions could reasonably need the precise mate counts, distributions, and uniqueness certificates. Incomplete global census is described honestly and not called complete, but does not erase the independently valuable exact stratum result. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration.

Uniqueness is over 1-partitions (mates up to C-symbol permutation); draft uses 'mate/partition' interchangeably — convention standard but a reader using labelled mates (10! relabellings) must adjust.
